data.exact_reserve_text: An overall release of prior year's provisions for claims during the year of approximately GBP 19.0m (2015: release of GBP 37.6m) was primarily driven by the favourable experience on the Marine accounts in Aviation and Marine of GBP 26.5m (2015: release of GBP 54.7m) and Property and Fire release of GBP 0.5m (2015: release of GBP 5.3m). This is offset by the adverse experience on the Public Liability accounts in Third Party Liability of GBP 11.0m (2015: strengthening of GBP 23.4m).

prior_year_events.event_name: Favourable experience on Marine accounts (Aviation and Marine)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Favourable claims development in the Marine/Aviation classes leading to a release of reserves.
Small favourable development on Property and Fire resulting in a minor release of reserves.

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse experience on Public Liability accounts (Third Party Liability)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse claims development in Third Party Liability producing a strengthening of reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an overall release of prior years' claims provisions of approximately GBP 19.0m in 2016. This release was driven principally by favourable development in the Marine/Aviation portfolios (c. GBP 26.5m) and a small release in Property and Fire (c. GBP 0.5m), partly offset by adverse development in Third Party Liability (c. GBP 11.0m). Net prior year development therefore resulted in an overall release.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development used the Managing Agent's narrative (note 6) which explicitly states an overall release of approximately GBP 19.0m. The note does not state 'net' and provides gross component amounts for certain classes; therefore this figure was used as the gross movement (confidence 0.8). A claims development triangle is present (page 34) but detailed cell extraction from the scanned image was not fully reliable; accordingly the triangle was not used to independently compute the aggregate prior year movement. All monetary amounts taken from tables are in GBP 000s in the report and were converted to millions for this output.
